leafDerivation.principle: Leaf pages are DERIVED from content/v1.5.3/{lang}/api/**, not enumerated here. This spec has ~20 buckets; the leaf list is in the thousands. Enumerating it would go stale the moment worker-3/worker-4 land a page.
leafDerivation.rule: For every file content/v1.5.3/{lang}/api/<slug>/<Type>.md there is exactly one Zola route /v1.5.3/{lang}/api/<slug>/<Type>/. The sidebar picks it up automatically because templates/macros/sidebar.html renders tree.byRoute[<bucket>].pages as 'has_children' and the section-tree lists subsections; a leaf needs NO navigation.json entry.
leafDerivation.collisionRule: If two namespaces mapped to the same bucket export the same simple type name, the file is <NamespaceLeaf>__<TypeName>.md (e.g. Campaign__IFaction.md). Never write two files for one type. Source: dirMap.collisionRule.
leafDerivation.counts: Per-bucket type counts are in bucketTaxonomy.buckets[].typesAfterOverride; sum = 11989 public/internal types across Bannerlord namespaces.

hierarchy.principle: Every level links UP, DOWN, and SIDEWAYS. No dead ends, no 404. The audit gate is `AUDIT_MODE=url AUDIT_CONTENT_ROOT=content/v1.5.3 node tools/audit-links.mjs` — BROKEN_LINKS must be 0.
hierarchy.criticalRule: audit-links.mjs treats each page route as its own DIRECTORY. So from a leaf at /v1.5.3/zh/api/campaign/Hero/ you must write ../campaign/ to reach its bucket, NOT ./campaign/. Step up once, then across. The mirror image: a SECTION INDEX at /v1.5.3/zh/api/campaign/ links to its own children with ./Hero, because its route directory is already api/campaign/. Getting these two backwards is the classic cause of the 'jump once and 404' complaint.
hierarchy.selfCheck: Rule of thumb: count how many .md files sit between your page and the bucket you are addressing. A bucket index is 0 levels deep from its bucket, so ./ is right; a leaf is 1 level deep, so ../ is right.

up.note: One .. because the leaf's own directory IS the bucket directory. Do NOT write ./ — that resolves to a child of the page.

sidewaysPrevNext.siblingRule: Same bucket only. Sibling leaf pages use ../<Type> with NO trailing slash. Order is supplied by data/page-navigation.json (regenerate, patch P7) — if a hand-written prev/next is preferred, derive it from the bucket's alphabetically sorted Type list and omit the link entirely for the first/last item rather than emitting an empty or dangling anchor.

down.toLeaves: one `[`<Type>`](./<Type>)` per leaf in this bucket
down.critical: LEADING ./ is correct HERE and only here. This page's own route directory IS the bucket directory, so ./<Type> resolves to /v1.5.3/{lang}/api/<slug>/<Type>/. Using ../<Type> here would escape up to api/ and 404.

sidewaysPrevNext.order: bucketTaxonomy.buckets[] order, flattened across groups in groupSummary order

down.toBuckets: one `[`<slug>`](./<slug>/)` per bucket — note the LEADING ./ here, because this page's route directory IS /api/, so ./campaign/ is correct and ../campaign/ would escape to the version root

table.sidewaysPrevNext: siblings are the version's other top sections (architecture, guide): see L1

sidewaysPrevNext.nextVersion: none — v1.5.3 is the newest. OMIT the next link entirely; do not emit an empty anchor.

down.toVersions: one row per version in the 选择版本 table — add v1.5.3 per patch P5

hierarchy.sameFileTrap: A page must never link to itself via its own route. content/v1.5.3/zh/_index.md links to ./api/ and ./architecture/, never to ./ . tools/fix-breadcrumb-self-links.mjs exists for exactly this class of bug.

openItems.item: override by bare type name can drag a same-named BCL or generated type into a mod-facing bucket
openItems.was: First-match on simple type name resolved Module -> mscorlib/System/Reflection/Module.cs, LoadContext -> mscorlib/System/Reflection/LoadContext.cs, Campaign -> SandBox/SandBoxGameManager.cs, instead of the intended TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade/Module.cs, TaleWorlds.SaveSystem/Load/LoadContext.cs and TaleWorlds.CampaignSystem/Campaign.cs.
openItems.now: LoadContext and Campaign are no longer in entryPointDirs at all, so the prefix rules place them correctly (save-system, campaign) and the dead-weight entries are gone.
openItems.residualRisk: The 7 surviving overrides are matched by BARE, CASE-SENSITIVE type name, not by (namespace, typeName) pair. 4 of them have a same-named type elsewhere in the 1.5.3 tree: Module also exists in mscorlib/System/Reflection; Mission and Agent also exist in TaleWorlds.MountAndBlade.AutoGenerated/ManagedCallbacks; MissionState also exists in StoryMode.Storymode.Missions. If the shared noise gate (which excludes BCL and AutoGenerated namespaces — unmapped dropped 52 -> 1) is ever removed or weakened, those copies would be dragged into core/ and mission/.
openItems.verifiedLanded: No leakage occurred. api/core/ contains exactly MBSubModuleBase.md + Module.md; api/mission/ contains exactly Mission, MissionState, MissionBehavior, Agent, Formation. Neither mscorlib nor ManagedCallbacks copies were published.
openItems.recommendation: No action needed now. If the noise gate ever changes, switch the override lookup to an (namespace, typeName) pair match.
